title.narrative: Strengthening capacity of teachers and learners from the region, covered by Almaty Regional Office, in promoting sustainable development and climate change education as creative and responsible global citizens through ESD and GEP initiatives

description.narrative: Overall purpose is to empower teachers and learners in the region with skills and competencies to promote sustainable development, including climate change education, engage with the world as responsible global citizens through ESD, GCED, SEL and GEP initiatives. Based on its work in the past biennium, UNESCO Almaty Regional office will continue its support to the countries under its coverage to improve the overall quality and relevance of education by strengthening the teaching and learning focus on the formation of functional literacy, critical thinking and transversal and green skills and competencies for sustainable development among learners. In particular, based on the ESD-2030 country initiatives, developed by the countries, and states' membership at Greening Education Partnership, UNESCO Almaty Regional office will support the ministries of education and partners in the implementation of these initiatives as well as to advance integration of climate change into national curricula and NDC 3.0. agenda and setting green school standards. In cooperation with the civil society organizations, UNESCO Almaty RO will continue supporting the countries in providing the platform for policy discussions on climate change education as well as preparing framework documents in advancing climate action through education. Based on the studies conducted in the past biennium, the education programme in the region will focus on strengthening the capacity of national education stakeholders as well as support the countries on developing the learning and teaching materials to mainstream ESD and Climate Change Education in education system.
